column1: # Vol V runover ledger — THE authoritative record of footer-runover tests.
# One line per chunk, in BUILD order. Every chunk in vol5/ must appear exactly
# once, including the ones that tested negative — the roster IS the denominator,
# and `tools/check-vol5-census.py` cross-checks it against the filesystem.
# That cross-check is the whole point: the 2026-07-28 tally fork happened
# because `bon-brev-prol` was silently dropped from a hand-carried count.
# Do NOT hand-increment a total anywhere. Append a line here; run the script.
# slug<TAB>events        events = "-" for negative, else comma-separated
